Submit message for delivery. If reference message ID is provided then EmailEngine adds all headers and flags required for a reply/forward automatically.<br/><br/>Delivery is asynchronous. A 2xx means the message was queued, not that it was sent. Failed attempts are retried with exponential backoff up to the configured deliveryAttempts; follow the outcome through the Outbox endpoints or the messageSent, messageDeliveryError and messageFailed webhooks.<br/><br/>For SMTP accounts EmailEngine uploads the sent message to the Sent Mail folder after delivery. Gmail API and MS Graph accounts file sent messages themselves, so no upload is performed.
